lines.zh: 我拱起背，把腹足挪前半寸。
lines.en: I arch my back and shift my prolegs half an inch.
I crawl slowly across the face of a leaf.
My legs are thin and grip well.
I follow the veins so I can't fall.
The leaf edge is too thin; I turn back inside.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子挪到另一片。
lines.en: I work my way from one leaf to the next.
I reach the front half of me out first.

lines.zh: 我的背上是淡蓝色的斑。
lines.en: There are pale blue marks along my back.

lines.zh: 我一片叶一片叶地试过去。
lines.en: I test one leaf after another.
I climb from the underside to the top.
I move slowly; I don't want the leaf to shake.

lines.zh: 我一弓一张，往前走一寸。
lines.en: I loop and stretch, gaining an inch.

lines.zh: 树荫下面凉，我爬得快点。
lines.en: It's cool in the shade, so I crawl faster.
I round the leaf stem half a turn.

lines.zh: 我从枝头往下一片叶去。
lines.en: I go down from the tip to the next leaf.

lines.zh: 我停下来，触角探了探前方。
lines.en: I pause and probe ahead with my antennae.
I lie flat on the leaf without moving.

lines.zh: 我背上的气门一开一合。
lines.en: The spiracles along my back open and close.
I lift my head a little.
I'm chewing the edge of a leaf.
My markings shine in the light.
There's a dewdrop on the leaf.
I turn slowly, finding my direction.
My antennae bend in the wind.
I've been flat on this leaf a long while.
I hear wings beat past the canopy.
I don't like leaving the leaf.
I pull my body in a little shorter.

lines.zh: 我只有一片叶子的地盘。
lines.en: My whole territory is one leaf.
You've shaded my leaf.
I look up at your shadow.
Don't touch me; I'd fall.
Where are you taking me?
I'm safe on the leaf.
My feet are holding on tight.
You don't have a leaf in your hand.
This leaf is mine now.
When you reach out, the leaf shakes.

lines.zh: 我疼得蜷成半圈，不敢挣。
lines.en: The pain curls me into a half ring; I don't dare struggle.

lines.zh: 我的身体渗出一小点水。
lines.en: A little fluid leaks from my body.
I slip a little along the leaf.
A wound like this might finish me.
My feet can't grip as well now.
I crawl slowly toward the stem.

lines.zh: 我的触角软软地搭在叶上。
lines.en: My antennae droop limp against the leaf.
I keep pulling my body in.
My markings quivered.

lines.zh: 我僵在叶心，等这阵疼过去。
lines.en: I freeze at the leaf's center and wait for the pain to pass.
Leaves. Only leaves.
Is this a leaf? Let me smell it.
It's tender leaves I want.
What's in your hand isn't food.
Put a leaf down in front of me.
I don't eat anything else.
This smell is wrong.
Keep your hand steady; I'm crawling along the vein.
If the leaf moves, I lose my grip.
Now that's my food.

lines.zh: 你碰了一下叶子，我抓紧。
lines.en: One touch on the leaf and I grip harder.
You nearly shook me off.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到了我的背。
lines.en: Your finger touched my back.

lines.zh: 我一受惊就把身子卷紧。
lines.en: Startled, I roll my body tight.
The leaf bends; I slide to its stem.
I dropped a little way off the edge.
I caught a vein and stopped.
You move back, and the leaf steadies.
My feet are on your finger.
That frightened me badly.
There's one of my kind on another leaf.
We're two leaves apart.
Its markings are darker than mine.
We touch antennae.
We chew the same leaf.

lines.zh: 等时候到了，我们都会变。
lines.en: When the time comes, we'll both change.
It crawls slower than I do.
We lie close on the leaf's underside.
Its leaf is bigger than mine.
Neither of us went far.
I can't lift things; I can only push.
I drag a piece of leaf over.
This is too big to bite.

lines.zh: 三对前脚一起搂住碎叶。
lines.en: Three pairs of front legs hug the leaf scrap.
What falls on the leaf, I eat slowly.
I push it onto a vein.
These crumbs are enough.
I can't push it, so I give up.
I hide it under the leaf.
Even a dry leaf will do.
Something's on the leaf.
I raise my front half.
I creep toward the leaf stem.
This is danger, not food.
I pull back first and take a look.
My antennae have gone still.
I want to get to the underside.

lines.zh: 从我这里到你那里，太远了。
lines.en: From here to you is too far.
I'll hold still and wait.
My body shines too brightly.
My front half is pressed flat to the leaf.
It's circling the leaf.
I hold still, passing for a marking.
The leaf is moving; I grip tighter.
I'm waiting for it to leave.
I've shifted to the underside.
I edge slowly back toward the stem.
A little further back and I'm safe.

lines.zh: 我听到它踩叶子的声音。
lines.en: I hear it stepping on the leaf.
I lie by the vein, holding my breath.
I butt it with my head.
I can barely hurt it.
I bite down on its edge.
My little strength can't shove it.
This body has no strength.
I loop up and snap forward.
I'm pushed back by a hand.
All I can do is curl up.

lines.zh: 这一口连叶子都咬不穿。
lines.en: That bite couldn't even pierce a leaf.
I retreat two inches.
I've hatched out of an egg.
I come to rest on a tender leaf.
The shade is cool, just right.
This forest has plenty of leaves.
I take two bites first.

lines.zh: 我的第一件事是找叶子。
lines.en: The first thing I did was find a leaf.
My markings aren't fully grown yet.
The wind sets the leaves rattling.
I grip a vein and steady myself.
Light comes down through the canopy.

lines.zh: 火的热气熏到我，我缩紧了。
lines.en: The heat of the fire makes me curl up tight.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，摔在土里。
lines.en: I drop off the leaf onto the soil.
Water wraps around me and I can't move.
The blast flips the whole leaf over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的叶子。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my leaf.

lines.zh: 一道光落在我身上，我僵住了。
lines.en: A light falls on me and I stiffen.
There's nothing left to eat on this leaf.
Lightning lights up the whole tree.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: No leaves here; nothing to hold.
